text:
People Ops: New temporary support: Same-Day Childcare Emergency PTO Top-Up + Backup Care Referrals now available company-wide. Short doc + request form: https://redwood.internal/policies/childcare-emergency (TL;DR below)

jordan_parent: TL;DR? that's great news if true 😅

People Ops: TL;DR 40 Redwood will pay up to 24 hours of backup care per incident (up to $200/day) and will allow a one-time PTO top-up of up to 3 days for same-day childcare emergencies. Claims open for incidents starting 2026-01-01. File within 7 days.

nina_manager: Is top-up paid out or advanced? How does it show on payroll?

People Ops: Top-up is an advance payment of PTO (shows as "PTO advance" on the paystub) and will be reconciled against future accruals over the following 8 pay periods. We don't reduce headcount balances immediately; reconciliation is backend.

benefits_team: Backup care referral process: use the vendor link on the policy page. Vendor will try to match same-day in-network providers; if none available they will provide a vetted list. Use code REDWOOD24 when booking to waive booking fees.

jordan_parent: Can contractors use backup care or submit for top-up?

People Ops: This pilot is for full-time Redwood employees only. Contractors are eligible for vendor referrals but not for paid top-ups.

nina_manager: Are receipts required? Any documentation privacy concerns?

People Ops: Yes upload provider receipt or vendor confirmation. You can redact sensitive details; we only need provider name, date, and amount. We store claims in HRIS with limited access.

care_vendor: Heads up: if you book through our portal the confirmation email + invoice will auto-populate into the claim form. If using a local provider, please upload a photo of the receipt.

jordan_parent: If someone uses both backup care and rebooks travel because of childcare, can they claim both?

People Ops: Yes, claims are considered per-incident and per-policy. Travel rebooking falls under the travel exception policy; both claims can be submitted but must be itemized and include receipts.
